command:
cat > /tmp/gdbtest5.cmd <<'EOF'
set pagination off
set confirm off
set architecture riscv:rv64
set language rust
target remote localhost:1234
break src/task/mod.rs:173
commands
  silent
  printf "END-OF-RUN\n"
  quit
end
set $a = 0
break src/mm/memory_set.rs:165
commands
  silent
  set $a = $a + 1
  if $a <= 1
    printf "from_elf entry:\n"
    info args
    bt 3
  end
  continue
end
set $b = 0
break src/mm/memory_set.rs:210
commands
  silent
  set $b = $b + 1
  if $b <= 1
    printf "from_elf stack:\n"
    p/x user_stack_bottom
    p/x user_stack_top
    p/x max_end_vpn.0
  end
  continue
end
set $c = 0
break src/mm/memory_set.rs:61
commands
  silent
  set $c = $c + 1
  if $c <= 2
    printf "insert_framed_area:\n"
    info args
  end
  continue
end
set $d = 0
break src/mm/page_table.rs:184
commands
  silent
  set $d = $d + 1
  if $d <= 2
    printf "translated_byte_buffer:\n"
    info args
  end
  continue
end
set $e = 0
break src/mm/page_table.rs:163
commands
  silent
  set $e = $e + 1
  if $e <= 2
    printf "translate_user:\n"
    info args
  end
  continue
end
set $f = 0
break src/syscall/process.rs:100
commands
  silent
  set $f = $f + 1
  if $f <= 3
    printf "sys_mmap:\n"
    info args
  end
  continue
end
continue
EOF
cd /home/starryreverie/userdata/development/rCore-Tutorial-Code-2026A && /tmp/gdbrun.sh /tmp/gdbtest5.cmd 600 2>&1 | grep -vE "^\[rustsbi\]" | tail -45; echo "EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
